intent: Project response-owned provider SessionStart identity into the Bun Helm chat-turn trace so a requested preview route remains the configured picker selection while the transcript names the model that actually answered. In particular, requested grok_oauth:grok-4.6 must render served grok_oauth:grok-4.6-build after response evidence, session.ack remains a pre-response fallback, incomplete SessionStart identity is ignored, and a later or replayed request acknowledgement cannot downgrade response-owned identity. Do not change picker state, route policy, provider transport, terminal layout, or Helm OnCall truth.

negative_controls.name: served-route-precedence-guard-removal-is-detected
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path('terminal/src/executionLog.ts'); t=p.read_text(); old='activeTurn.routeSource !== \"provider_session_start\"'; new='true'; (t.count(old) == 1) or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(old,new,1)); sys.exit(0 if old in p.read_text() else 1)"

interface_mismatches: The bridge preserves requested preview selection separately from response-owned served identity, but the Bun execution log currently ignores session_start and therefore labels the answer only with the pre-response session.ack route.
Grok account transport truthfully requests grok-4.6 and returns grok-4.6-build; without event projection the operator cannot see that distinction in the turn trace.
honest_blockers: This packet changes transcript/event projection only. The picker and configured selection intentionally remain the requested route, while the completed turn names response-owned served identity.
AgentOps positive gates cannot invoke Bun directly; focused Bun tests, typecheck, and Terminal Guardian 80x24 smoke are mandatory external verification before commit.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the packet-scoped event-projection commit. Provider adapters, requested picker selection, route policy, durable receipts, and Helm OnCall truth remain unchanged.
